content:
With Apple's biggest annual product launch — the September iPhone event — just one month away, here's what to expect based on the various rumors.

iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra

This year's flagship iPhone lineup is reportedly set to be the smallest in years, while also being the most expensive.

That's because multiple signs point to the standard iPhone 18 not arriving until early 2027, with the iPhone Air 2 also expected to be delayed in tandem.

So, expect three new iPhones next month:

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, new colors, smaller Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: Everything above, plus a larger battery
  • iPhone Ultra: A new design, the company's first foldable iPhone

Analysts expect the iPhone 18 Pro to start at around $1,399, while the iPhone Ultra is expected to retail for around $1,999. Here's hoping Apple prices things lower than expected.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12

New Apple Watches land every September, and this year is expected to be no different.

Here are the two rumored new Apple Watch models:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, refreshed design, and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: More powerful SiP, new health features

Details on both new watches remain pretty thin right now. That might mean the changes this year are relatively minor — or it could just be that Apple has plenty of surprises left to reveal.

Wildcards: New AirPods Pro, Apple Home products

iPhones and Apple Watches are almost certain to appear at the September event, but Apple could use the opportunity to launch other products, too.

Most likely among them are new AirPods and Apple Home products.

  • AirPods Pro with a camera: The camera powers AI features, with potential applications in health and accessibility
  • A new Apple TV 4K: More powerful chip to support Apple Intelligence and Siri AI
  • HomePad/HomePod Touch: A Siri-centric HomePod with a display
  • HomePod mini 2: Siri AI support, new chip, better sound
  • HomePod 3: Siri AI support and a new chip, with relatively limited changes elsewhere
  • Apple Home Security Camera: A home security camera with HomeKit Secure Video support

Apple has plenty of other fall products that could land next month too, like a new OLED iPad mini, a new MacBook Pro, and Ultra models. But those are widely expected to be delayed until an October event.

Which Apple product are you planning to pick up at the September event? Let us know in the comments.
